name: DevLog - A Post-Modern College Experience
source:
Play as Dev, a human new to the all saurian Cretaceous College of Computing! He never thought he would actually be accepted into CCC when he applied - much less be offered a full ride. From here on out, Dev's choices will impact who he meets and his eventual fate in this whole new world - and the fates of those around him, as well.

Inspired by Snoot Game and I Wani Hug That Gator.

[From [url=https://devlog-game.itch.io/devlog-game]Itch.io[/url]]
